# DentaSource Direct

> Premium dental equipment distributor — exclusive Philippine partner for ROSON (dental chairs) and Denjoy (endodontics equipment). One of the largest dental equipment showrooms in the Philippines at 140 sqm in Pasig City. Clinically backed by FFC Dental Clinic (5 branches, 30+ dentists).

## About

- **Business name:** DentaSource Direct (also DentaSource, DSD, DentaSource Direct Dental Supply)
- **Founded:** October 2024
- **Tagline:** Step into the future of your practice.
- **Location:** 610 C. Maybunga Road, Pasig City, Metro Manila, Philippines 1607
- **Phone:** +63 962 579 3024
- **Website:** https://dentasourcedirect.com
- **Facebook:** https://www.facebook.com/dentasource
- **Showroom:** 140 sqm — one of the largest dental equipment showrooms in the Philippines
- **Training center:** Merced Square 2, Pasig City
- **Hours:** 9:00 AM – 8:00 PM, daily (7 days a week)

## What we sell

### ROSON (exclusive Philippine distributor)
Dental chairs across four tiers: Flagship A3 (KLT-6220, EOW disinfection), A3S, S-series (S9, S6, S3), N-series (N2 Pro, N2 Plus, N1).

### Denjoy (exclusive Philippine distributor)
Endodontics equipment — the most digitally advanced endo system in the Philippines:
- **Meet Endo All-in-One** (flagship) — integrated digital endo hub with centralized charging, real-time data visualization, and intelligent wireless pairing across modules
- **FREE PEX** — 6th-generation multi-frequency apex locator
- **i-Pexo** — high-precision touchscreen apex locator
- **AIKE** — ultrasonic endo activator for root canal irrigation
- **imate3** — cordless endo motor

### Additional categories
- Dental X-ray and imaging
- Dental microscopes
- Curing and filling tools
- Sterilization equipment
- Dental accessories

## Our differentiators

- **Clinically owned** by a practicing dentist running 5 clinics with 30+ associates seeing 170–300 patients/day
- **Showroom-first experience** — customers can test-sit every flagship chair before purchasing
- **White-glove delivery** — unpacking, placement, and setup included
- **Free Metro Manila installation** — professional positioning, connections, calibration
- **Nationwide delivery** — same-week dispatch from Manila stock to Cebu, Davao, Iloilo, Baguio, and the rest of Luzon/Visayas/Mindanao
- **Hands-on training** — staff walkthrough on operation, maintenance, workflow
- **Local warranty + service** — Manila service center, stocked parts, no offshore delays
- **After-sales support** — rehousing, repairs, parts sourcing, ongoing coverage
- **Free ocular visitation** before purchase — assess clinic space, recommend configuration
- **2-year warranty on chairs** — Year 1 parts + service; Year 2 service only
- **Trade-in program** — credit old equipment toward new purchases
- **Flexible financing** — zero down payment, installment plans tailored to clinic cash flow
- **Digital integration** (Denjoy) — the only Philippine endo system with centralized charging, real-time data, and wireless module pairing
